spec: TRACK 15 — Wearable-IMU aquatic distress/drowning-detection literature (v54's new future-work roadmap). Tracker v54 already formulated specific parameters as a documented future-research extension: stroke cadence monitoring (0.4-1.6Hz cyclic analysis), Instinctive Drowning Response struggle index (>2.5Hz vertical pressing), submersion immobility timeout (>15s stillness, vertical orientation). Research published wearable-IMU aquatic-distress/drowning-detection literature to check these specific parameter ranges against what's actually been validated in prior work, and note any gaps or corrections. Deliverable: validation/correction of the three logged parameters plus any additional literature-backed detail worth folding into the roadmap, kept as future-work scope (not a build task).
